summary: The Laxmi Memorial Cup 2026 was organised to encourage children to participate in sports, develop teamwork, build confidence, and promote a healthy lifestyle through football.
description:
The Laxmi Memorial Cup 2026 was organised to encourage children to participate in sports, develop teamwork, build confidence, and promote a healthy lifestyle through football. Our aim is to empower children through sports, education, and life skills, creating opportunities for every child to learn, play, and grow.
Time: 7:00 am to 3:00 pm at Backgarden
Categories - Age Group: 8–13 Years, Total Players: 60, Total Teams: 9 and Age Group: 15–17 Years, Total Players: 25, Total Teams: 6
TOURNAMENT HIGHLIGHTS
85 participants through 15 Teams, Trophies and medals for the winners sponsored by Rotary Club Bombay Pier, Snacks for all children participating in the match
A heartfelt thank you to Rtn Kaajal Thadani and our Club for supporting the tournament and helping make this event special for our children. Every child is a winner when they learn, play, and grow together!
Project cost Rs 20,000/-
